A Shakespeare-inspired strategy game

THE GHOST OF DENMARK

Truth is hidden in Elsinore. Every choice has a consequence.

📖 Rulebook: How to Play

Welcome to The Ghost of Denmark, a board game inspired by Shakespeare’s Hamlet. Your goal is to understand the tragedy, collect Evidence Points, and finish with the strongest case. The 50 spaces follow the major events of the play in story order.

1. Take your turn

Roll the dice. Your character piece moves automatically, one space at a time. The highlighted space and the position guide show where every piece is.

2. Choose a card

When you land on a marked space, the matching cards appear below the board. Pick one of the three displayed cards from that category. The effect shown on that exact card is the effect applied. Story spaces have no card.

3. Card spaces

📜 Evidence: gain or lose Evidence. 🎭 Event: a story event changes your turn. ⚖️ Choice: choose between two actions. 🕯️ Consequence: accept a helpful or difficult result.

4. Win the game

The first player to reach the Final Chamber ends the game. The player with the most Evidence Points wins. A tie goes to the player farther along the board; if still tied, it is a draw.

Character abilities: Your chosen character’s ability is shown during character selection and remains available through the game. Press “Use character ability” on your turn whenever you want; it can be used once per game. Claudius and Horatio can activate protection that stays ready until its trigger happens. The computer opponent chooses when to use its own ability.
